7.4.3.5.2.4 Binary Manifest
The implementation of the Dem High Proxy may require some basic infrastructure from the Dem Low Proxy in order to be operational. Such generic infrastructure services can be linked between Application Software Cluster and Host Software Cluster by means of a Dem base socket. module
[SWS_SwCluC_02744] Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00209, SRS_SwCluC_00212
⌈The Dem High Proxy shall create for each SwCluCDemProxyBaseSocket a required resource entry in the Binary Manifest.⌋
[SWS_SwCluC_02745] Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00209, SRS_SwCluC_00212
⌈The Dem High Proxy shall create for each diagnostic event proxy - configured via SwCluCDemProxyDiagnosticEvent container - a required resource entry in the Binary Manifest.⌋
